          example: George

          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is the
            composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. When given in E.164 form the
            national-number length must match the country code: '+61' requires 9
            national digits and '+1' requires 10. A number without a country code is
            treated as Australian ('+61'), i.e. 9 national digits after dropping a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[ ()\-./]*(?:\+[ ()\-./]*6[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|\+[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){10}|0(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|[1-9](?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){8})[ ()\-./]*$'

          format: email
          maxLength: 255

          format: date

          example: false

          description: >-

            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressRequired"
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR/MRS/MS/DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is the
            composed, normalized address returned in responses.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. When given in E.164 form the
            national-number length must match the country code: '+61' requires 9
            national digits and '+1' requires 10. A number without a country code is
            treated as Australian ('+61'), i.e. 9 national digits after dropping a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[ ()\-./]*(?:\+[ ()\-./]*6[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|\+[ ()\-./]*1(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){10}|0(?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){9}|[1-9](?:[ ()\-./]*[0-9]){8})[ ()\-./]*$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.DisposableEmailValidation"
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent(message = \"registrationDate must not be later than the current date\")"
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city
            region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials

All tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`). The runtime log confirms the new behavior end-to-end:
- `memberId=V2NSW2616E6609E9` — the version-2 tag now lives **inside** the identifier's region code.
- Audit event: `{"seq":1,...,"ownerSegment":"STANDARD_METRO","schemaVersion":2,"event":"OWNER_CREATED"}` — schema version 2 with the recomputed owner segment (plain `METRO`, no V2 leak).
- The response test passed asserting `apiVersion=2` and the nested `identity.{memberId,identityKey,householdId}` with those three gone from the top level.

## What changed

I released owner-identity v2 by mixing a fixed `"V2"` tag into each identifier's derivation, keeping every edit a tiny, self-contained change:

**Identity derivation** (one line each, in the small derivation classes that own each identifier):
- `CustomerCode.of` — the region code inside the memberId is now `"V2" + region` (e.g. `V2NSW…`). `region(owner)` is untouched, so `locality`/`timezone`/segment stay plain.
- `IdentityKeys.of` — hashes `"V2|" + …`, so the key changes but equality relationships (duplicate/soft-match) are preserved.
